items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I went to the union the other day to get a record check, a residual from something that I did with Alberta Hunter

ctx.x: Well, what about the situation with Alberta Hunter?

Well, with Alberta Hunter we got into a personality clash with the pianist, and my expertise was a little too much for him to take, with his master's degree, and my common statement is that I have a Ph.D. in the street, you know, and he couldn't buy that.

And all the well wishers came to me because they didn't know him, and I introduced him to everybody. Everybody I spoke to, I introduced him, but we were -- it wasn't on a leader basis relationship. I just thought it was two people. We'd play like two people. But --
